purpose: Fill the exact one-B70 Q4_K_M plus Q4_0 MTP2 many-user gap with output-audited native HTTP measurements rather than target-only transfer or projection.

identity.gpu: one Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GiB

measurement.required_speed_stability: both attempts pass; relative range at every point <=10%
measurement.required_output_gate: 128 complete raw token IDs per response, cached_tokens=0, unique expanded prompts, no cross-base sequential-oracle collision
measurement.required_semantic_gate: each fresh server passes two rounds of 64 synchronized exact-answer requests (128 requests per attempt) with cached_tokens=0

sequential_mtp0_oracle.boundary: Exact-match counts are reported but not required above one user because target-only greedy output is itself batch-shape-dependent across fresh servers. Isolation plus concurrent semantic quality is required instead.
